name: computor
description: VS Code extension for computor teaching software

commands.title: Reveal Documents Mirror in File Explorer
Move MATLAB Workspace to the Secondary Side Bar

view/item/context.when: view == computor.tutor.courses && (viewItem == tutorStudentContent.assignment.hasRepo || viewItem == tutorStudentContent.assignment.noRepo || viewItem == tutorVirtualFolder.submissions || viewItem == tutorSubmissionArtifact || viewItem == tutorVirtualFolder.reference)
view == computor.lecturer.examples && (viewItem == exampleCheckedOut || viewItem == exampleLocalOnly) && computor.examples.canAuthor
view == computor.lecturer.examples && (viewItem == checkedOutWorking || viewItem == checkedOutVersion || viewItem == exampleCheckedOut || viewItem == exampleLocalOnly)
view == computor.lecturer.examples && (viewItem == workingFolder || viewItem == workingFolderProtected || viewItem == workingFolderContent)
view == computor.lecturer.examples && (viewItem == workingFolder || viewItem == workingFolderProtected || viewItem == workingFolderContent)

scripts.package: npm run type-check && webpack --mode production --devtool hidden-source-map
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile:fast && npm run lint
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:integration
